shared_elements: low-relief carving covering the face of the stone
horizontal register or band dividing the composition
frontal figure with prominent head and arms held across the body
rows of small repeated elements forming a decorative band
justification: Both are tall, flat-faced stone slabs carved in shallow relief with imagery stacked in horizontal registers, and each has a large central frontal figure whose arms bend inward over the torso beneath a band of small repeated motifs. The manner of carving differs sharply, however: A uses sparse, thin, outline-like incision on plain ground with isolated animal silhouettes, while B is densely packed with deeply modelled, ornament-laden human figuration filling every part of the field, and the two are also presented in wholly different contexts (open excavation versus lit museum display).
